input: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (scheduled ventures brief)
task: Deepen (flagship 12) ids-model-check: WHERE rules (express_rules=True), the BUILDABLE item 2 the router picked
errors: First IfcOpenShell --rules sweep ran without pytest installed; ifcopenshell.express.rule_executor imports _pytest and every file came back 'ModuleNotFoundError'. Killed it, installed pytest in the venv, reran.

First comparison of rule lines missed thousands of IfcOpenShell failures: eval/conformance_ifcopenshell.py cuts messages at 300 characters and long rule texts lost their 'Violated by'. Fixed the classifier and made the script record each line's logged type.

Made all string equality case-blind to match one IfcOpenShell fixture (IfcBoxAlignment 'CENTER'); it invented duplicate quantity names (ARCHICAD 'Breite links'/'Breite Links'). Reverted to case-sensitive with a one-type exception.
First venture-preflight ran before an inherited_keys lint fix and failed on TYPE_NOTES[...]; fixed with Object.hasOwn and reran.

doc_friction.issue: Truncates IfcOpenShell messages to 300 characters without recording the logged statement type, so later scripts cannot tell a long rule line from an attribute line; added a 'type' field.
Says the web-ifc IfcOpenShell run takes about 50 minutes; with express_rules=True on top it was the slowest step of this run and the note gave no hint that pytest must be installed for --rules.

deviations.why: Default is to land a slice and rewrite the flagship's next:; the item landed lived in buildable:, so buildable: was rewritten instead (the router's own instruction) and next: left as is.

goal: Run the IFC schema's own WHERE rules inside the free IDS checker, matched against ifcopenshell.validate(express_rules=True).
notes: Built where-rules.mjs, an EXPRESS (ISO 10303-11) interpreter: expressions with EXPRESS precedence, three-valued logic, QUERY, intervals, aggregate initialisers, entity constructors and ||, functions with LOCAL/IF/CASE/REPEAT/RETURN/assignment, DERIVE attributes, inverses, global RULEs, defined-type rules, SET and ARRAY-bound semantics. schema/gen-rules.mjs extracts rules from the buildingSMART .exp files (363/677/777 rules, matching IfcOpenShell's counts). Wired into conformance.mjs (CLI --conformance, --no-rules; page MODEL block via worker.mjs). Verification: node --test where-rules.test.mjs 12/12; python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py ids-model-check: 597 tests ok (2 skipped); inherited_keys 0 new; check_posts ok; page driven in Chromium showing the two WHERE findings in the MODEL block. Beside ifcopenshell 0.9.0.post1 express_rules=True on 492 public files: 26,013 failures found by both on the same records, 21 only here (beam-standard-case IFC4 class in IFC4X3), 18 only IfcOpenShell (10 TypeError in its runner, 5 underivable TrueNorth, 2 indeterminate-as-true, 1 string in a length). Speed: AC20-FZK-Haus 0.31 s vs IfcOpenShell rule runner 4.0 s; 492 files ~70 s.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an EXPRESS interpreter covering IFC's rules and functions, a rule extractor, a 492-file comparison against IfcOpenShell with five semantic fixes, tests and write-ups: about a work week for a senior engineer who knows EXPRESS

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
